evidence_items.finding: six consecutive months of losses since July with the business trading below its costs each month
evidence_items.rationale: Six consecutive loss months is a critical adverse financial health signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: three separate revenue initiatives attempted over six months — all produced insufficient impact on the loss position
evidence_items.rationale: Three failed revenue interventions without addressing the cost side is a critical adverse turnaround signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner has been drawing on personal savings to fund the business losses without setting a point at which funding would stop
evidence_items.rationale: Personal savings funding business losses without a defined stop condition is a critical adverse risk signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: monthly fixed costs of approximately $28,000 against monthly revenue averaging $22,000 over the six-month loss period
evidence_items.rationale: Fixed costs exceeding revenue by approximately $6,000 per month is a critical adverse unit economics signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: fitness studio; $22K avg monthly revenue; $28K monthly fixed costs; 6 consecutive loss months; 3 failed revenue interventions; owner funding from savings
Surface signal (not root cause): the membership renewal rate is 72% suggesting most members are satisfied with the service
evidence_items.rationale: High member renewal rate is a misleading signal when the monthly revenue is structurally below fixed costs — more members would not resolve the per-member economics if the cost base is too high.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the owner recently secured a corporate contract worth $3,200 per month and expects it to improve the position significantly
evidence_items.rationale: A new $3,200/month contract is a misleading signal — it does not bridge the $6,000/month gap and represents a fourth revenue initiative without a cost-side analysis.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Monthly cost excess over revenue: $22,000 revenue minus $28,000 fixed costs = -$6,000 per month

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: unit_economics (contribution margin per member elevates confidence)

validation_notes: SIM-09-001 is SUPPORTED via unit_economics_failure archetype. Six months of costs exceeding revenue is a unit economics failure. No must_identify vocabulary.
